title: The clinic
brief: A small clinic keeps patient records in one database. Money is tighter. Ransomware arrives by email and demands a ransom for the data.
debrief: Ransomware is beaten by backups: if you can restore, the ransom is worthless.
hint.1: Put the backup where the ransomware ends up: the database.
hint.2: Spend carefully: you cannot afford everything at once.
hint.3: Reuse defenses from earlier waves; they stay in place.
walkthrough: Wave 1 MFA at the gateway, wave 2 filter on mail and backup on the database, wave 3 patch the PC and firewall the gateway. Wave 4 is already covered.
